name: Dweebs
why_included: Ample seating, outlets and fast wifi; plenty of indoor space for groups.

name: Postmark Cafe
why_included: Quiet with lots of seating, fast wifi, plenty of outlets, printer available.

name: Variety Coffee (7th Ave)
why_included: Outlets, free WiFi, public restroom; very popular so arrive early; small quartz tables.

name: Mushtari Cafe
why_included: Spacious, laptop-friendly with WiFi and plant-filled back area; good lunch.

name: Stone Street Coffee (Broome St)
why_included: Eight-seat community table indoors plus big backyard table, lots of plugs, solid WiFi; group-friendly.

name: Verse Cafe
why_included: Wifi, tables and minimal decor; reliable wifi, best on weekdays.

name: Brooklyn Public Library - Central Library
why_included: Info Commons public co-working space (room and outlets for 70+ laptops); bookable meeting rooms; open 9am-8pm Mon-Thu. Group.

name: Oculus (World Trade Center)
why_included: Free WTC wifi throughout and some seating areas; few tables, so better for short sessions than long workdays.

name: 53rd Street Library
why_included: Modern TEN Arquitectos branch near MoMA with oak bleacher amphitheater and a laptop bar.

name: Whole Foods Market Tribeca (upstairs cafe)
why_included: Upstairs cafe open 7am-10pm with some outlets and quiet north-window seats; can be loud. Buy a snack.
